data.name: Elijah
data.gender_notes: Elijah is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Eliyyahu: Eli, 'my God', + Yahu, 'Yahweh'. Its root is Hebrew ʾ-l-y-h-w. The prophet Elijah (1 Kings 17). Elijah is a Hebrew name meaning “My God is Yahweh”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Elijah expresses “My God is Yahweh”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Eliyyahu: Eli, 'my God', + Yahu, 'Yahweh'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elijah total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
